title: Rationally Linearized MLPs
abstract: arXiv:2610.13568v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present Rationally Linearized Multilayer Perceptrons(RaLiMPs), a new approach to efficiently linearizing MLPs using low-degree rational approximations of standard activation functions. Inspired by polynomial-based MLP linearization, we show that rational approximations can provide accurate representations at substantially lower degree. RaLiMPs exploit these approximations to construct kernel representations with narrow bottlenecks, enabling efficient composition across MLP layers. We provide theoretical guarantees for the resulting approximation and evaluate RaLiMPs across applications ranging from implicit 3D models to large language models. Our experiments demonstrate favorable accuracy--efficiency tradeoffs, with RaLiMPs achieving competitive or improved accuracy while substantially reducing inference cost.

translated_title: 有理线性化多层感知机
translated_abstract: 我们提出了有理线性化多层感知机，这是一种利用标准激活函数的低次有理近似来高效线性化MLP的新方法。受基于多项式的MLP线性化方法启发，我们证明有理近似能够以显著更低的次数提供精确的表示。RaLiMPs利用这些近似构建具有窄瓶颈的核表示，从而实现跨MLP层的高效组合。我们为所得近似提供了理论保证，并在从隐式3D模型到大语言模型等多种应用上对RaLiMPs进行了评估。实验表明，RaLiMPs具有良好的精度-效率权衡，在大幅降低推理成本的同时达到了具有竞争力或更优的精度。
tldr: RaLiMPs利用低次有理近似替代标准激活函数来高效线性化MLP，在从隐式3D模型到大语言模型的多种应用中，以更低的推理成本实现了具有竞争力甚至更优的精度。
en_tdlr: RaLiMPs efficiently linearize MLPs using low-degree rational approximations of standard activation functions, achieving competitive or improved accuracy with substantially reduced inference cost across applications from implicit 3D models to large language models.
